comment: The attack, decay and release CVs are added as seconds directly, so one volt at a full attenuverter adds one second. The shape and sustain sumRanges are positions rather than voltages: knob plus CV is clamped to 0-1. The amplifier section is only calculated when one of its outputs has a cable in it (Enver.cpp:692). The LVL jack behaves differently on the two paths: Enver.cpp:701 multiplies the knob by the voltage over ten for a monophonic envelope, while :738 adds the voltage over ten to the knob when the envelope is polyphonic. The README's tip about using the LVL jack for velocity, with the knob at zero, only holds on the polyphonic path.
